MdeditorMdeditor

Android 上的 Markdown 编辑器：Flutter 做壳，Milkdown 做内核A Markdown editor for Android: Flutter shell, Milkdown core

在 Android 上做 Markdown 编辑器，纯 Flutter 路线意味着自己实现富文本的光标定位、选区和输入法合成，每件都是独立工程。我把编辑内核换成跑在 WebView 里的 Milkdown，Flutter 留下文件、设置、主题和导出。文档走 Android SAF，打开、编辑、保存始终指向同一个 URI。Building a Markdown editor on Android, the all-Flutter route means hand-writing caret positioning, selection and IME composition — three separate projects on their own. I moved the editing core into Milkdown inside a WebView and left Flutter with files, settings, theme and export. Documents go through Android SAF, so open, edit and save keep pointing at the same URI.

技术栈Stack

  • Flutter
  • Milkdown
  • WebView
  • Android SAF

亮点Highlights

  1. 编辑内核不自己写I did not write the editing core

    Milkdown 基于 ProseMirror，解析层是 remark，标题、列表、表格、代码块在输入时就成形，不需要再开一个预览窗。Milkdown sits on ProseMirror with remark underneath, so headings, lists, tables and code blocks take shape as you type instead of in a preview pane next to a text box.

  2. 代码块是一等公民Code blocks are first-class

    语法高亮随主题切换重建，带行号、折叠和一键复制；导出 DOCX 时高亮按 token 保留。Highlighting rebuilds when the theme switches, with line numbers, folding and one-tap copy; in the DOCX export the tokens survive.

  3. 手写 OOXML 导出Hand-rolled OOXML

    document.xml、样式、编号、页眉页脚、目录和媒体关系自己写，不用动辄几十兆的跨平台文档库。document.xml, styles, numbering, headers and footers, the table of contents and the media relationships are written by hand instead of pulling in a cross-platform document library that runs to tens of megabytes.

  4. SAF 让文件待在原地SAF keeps the file where it is

    取到 URI 后调用 takePersistableUriPermission，重启应用接着写，不会多出一份拷贝。Once the URI is picked up, takePersistableUriPermission holds the grant, so the app reopens on the same document after a restart and no stray copy appears in storage.

  5. 一条桥，一个协议One bridge, one protocol

    Flutter 和 WebView 只通过 MdBridge 说话，消息统一是 {type, ...} 的 JSON，目前只有 ready 和 changed 两种。Flutter and the WebView only speak through MdBridge. Every message is JSON shaped {type, ...}, and there are exactly two kinds: ready and changed.

  6. 开源可下载Open source and installable

    GitHub Actions 为每个版本自动打包 APK，GPL-3.0，README 有中英日法四份。GitHub Actions packages the APK for every release, GPL-3.0, with a README in Chinese, English, Japanese and French.
